name: resumator
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 514). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.109B parameters (identical tensor set). 768 native dims, Matryoshka-trained so the card benchmarks it truncated to 384 - cheaper than the 768-dim baseline at equal or better separation. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Caveat: the held-out ground truth was scored by the same LLM-judge family that labelled the training pairs, so the absolute Spearman is optimistic. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-03-11.

Ground truth scored by Cerebras gpt-oss-120b; the same judge family labelled the training pairs, so this is self-scored.
